purpose: Separates relationship-CLASS vocabulary (governed schema concepts) from relationship-INSTANCE truth (requires evidence).
rules: A relationship class is a controlled schema concept and may exist without asserting any instance.
The existence of a class does NOT depend on a supporting source.
A relationship INSTANCE (e.g. 'ENTITY-X -> importer -> Morocco -> period Y') requires evidence references and is NOT created in this sprint.
When introduced later, every relationship instance must carry >=1 evidence_id.
Relationship classes/instances never generate routes by themselves.

proposed_source_categories.note: Schema-integrity PROPOSAL only (concept-lexeme-resolution sprint). These primary/authoritative categories are NOT yet added to source_registry.json's approved categories, and NO sources are invented. Adding them is a later, separately-approved governance step. Trade/economic relationship INSTANCES must not be qualified by market_report/industry_publication alone.

evidence_strength_rule: For importer/exporter/producer/industrial_user instances, at least one PRIMARY authoritative source is required to reach evidence_qualified; secondary_contextual sources may add context but never establish the instance alone.

relationship_instance_schema.note: evidence_ids MUST be non-empty for qualification_state == 'evidence_qualified'.

relationship_classes.label: supply_chain_node
relationship_classes.definition: Place is a node in the supply chain.

relationship_classes.label: research_center
relationship_classes.definition: Place hosts research relevant to the entity.

relationship_classes.label: terminology_origin
relationship_classes.definition: Place/language is the origin of a lexical form of the entity.

relationship_classes.label: regulatory_jurisdiction
relationship_classes.definition: Jurisdiction governs a statement about the entity.
